item.text: {"iteration":1,"pcvs":[{"name":"incoming_count","expression":"len(requests)","rationale":"Captures iteration, source heap copying, and one destination insertion per incoming request."},{"name":"incoming_count_squared","expression":"len(requests) ** 2","rationale":"Approximates the increasing cost of source heap removals across the bounded incoming queue sizes."},{"name":"overlapping_priorities","expression":"min(len(requests), len(self._heap))","rationale":"For this workload, captures incoming priorities shared with the destination, which require arrival-time comparisons."}],"hypothesis":"Cost is dominated by incoming request count and source heap removal work, with additional comparisons when incoming and destination priorities coincide."}
